| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Smoothing weight** `weight` | 0.1 | 0.001 to 2 | The weight w = 1 / lambda, on the image from 0 to 1. Chambolle gets w, and split Bregman gets 1 / (2 w). That is how the scikit-image docstrings relate the two. scikit-image uses 0.1 for Chambolle and 5 for split Bregman, the same lambda. |
| **Solver** `solver` | Chambolle | Chambolle, Split Bregman | Chambolle's dual projection, or the split Bregman method of Goldstein and Osher, both from scikit-image. They do not give the same image at the same weight, see the docs page. |
| **Iterations** `iterations` | 200 | 1 to 2000 | The most steps. scikit-image uses 200 for Chambolle and 100 for split Bregman. Each solver also stops at its own tolerance. |
| **Isotropic** `isotropic` | on | On or off | For split Bregman only. On, the gradient size is the square root of the sum of squares. Off, it is the sum of the absolute values, which favors edges along the axes. scikit-image uses isotropic. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
